title: go to work / go home / go to the cinema
summary: Устойчивые выражения без артикля (**go to work, go to school, go to bed, go home**) и с артиклем **the** (**go to the cinema, the bank, the doctor**).
ru:
## Без артикля: когда место — это «деятельность»
Есть слова, после которых **не ставим the**, если речь об обычной функции этого места (работать, учиться, спать, лечиться).
> I'm going to **work** now. — Я иду на работу.
> What did you learn at **school** today? — Чему вы научились в школе сегодня?
> Helen wants to go to **university**. — Хелен хочет поступить в университет.
> Jack had to go to **hospital**. — Джеку пришлось лечь в больницу.
> I'm tired. I'm going to **bed**. — Я устала. Иду спать.
> David usually goes to **church** on Sundays. — Дэвид обычно ходит в церковь по воскресеньям.
> Why is he in **prison**? — Почему он в тюрьме?

## Таблица: куда / где
- **(go) to work** — **(be) at work**: *She's **at work**.*
- **(go) to school** — **(be) at school**
- **(go) to university / college** — **(be) at university**
- **(go) to hospital** — **(be) in hospital** (лежать в больнице)
- **(go) to prison** — **(be) in prison**
- **(go) to church** — **(be) in / at church**
- **(go) to bed** — **(be) in bed**
- **(go) home** — **(be) at home**

## home — без to
**go home**, но **be at home**. Слово to перед home не нужно.
> I'm going **home**. (не ~~to home~~)
> Are you going out tonight or staying **at home**?

## С the: просто здания
Если это **место, здание**, куда идут по делу (а не «учиться», «лечиться»), ставим **the**.
> I never go to **the** theatre but I often go to **the** cinema. — Я никогда не хожу в театр, но часто хожу в кино.
> 'Are you going to **the** bank?' 'No, **the** post office.' — Ты идёшь в банк? — Нет, на почту.
> You're not well. Why don't you go to **the** doctor? — Ты плохо себя чувствуешь. Сходи к врачу.
> I'm going to **the** dentist tomorrow. — Завтра иду к дантисту.
Также **the station, the airport, the city centre**.

## Почему так
- **go to school** = учиться (функция).
- **go to the school** = прийти в здание школы (например, на встречу родителей).
> I go to school every day. (я ученик)
> I'm going to the school to meet my son's teacher. (в здание)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I'm going to the work.~~ → I'm going to **work**.
- ~~She is at the school.~~ (она ученица) → She is at **school**.
- ~~I'm going to home.~~ → I'm going **home**.
- ~~I go to cinema.~~ → I go to **the** cinema.
en:
## No article: when the place is an activity
After some words we **don't use the** when we talk about what people usually do there (work, study, sleep, get treatment).
> I'm going to **work** now.
> What did you learn at **school** today?
> Helen wants to go to **university**.
> Jack had to go to **hospital**.
> I'm tired. I'm going to **bed**.
> David usually goes to **church** on Sundays.
> Why is he in **prison**?

## Going and being
- **(go) to work** — **(be) at work**
- **(go) to school** — **(be) at school**
- **(go) to university / college** — **(be) at university**
- **(go) to hospital** — **(be) in hospital**
- **(go) to prison** — **(be) in prison**
- **(go) to church** — **(be) in / at church**
- **(go) to bed** — **(be) in bed**
- **(go) home** — **(be) at home**

## home — no "to"
> I'm going **home**. (not ~~to home~~)
> Are you staying **at home**?

## With the: buildings and services
> I never go to **the** theatre but I often go to **the** cinema.
> 'Are you going to **the** bank?' 'No, **the** post office.'
> Why don't you go to **the** doctor?
> I'm going to **the** dentist tomorrow.
Also **the station, the airport, the city centre**.

## Why?
- **go to school** = to study there
- **go to the school** = to visit the building
> I go to school every day.
> I'm going to the school to meet my son's teacher.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I'm going to the work.~~ → I'm going to **work**.
- ~~I'm going to home.~~ → I'm going **home**.
- ~~I go to cinema.~~ → I go to **the** cinema.
structure:
## Без the
| Идти | Находиться |
|---|---|
| go to work | be at work |
| go to school | be at school |
| go to university / college | be at university |
| go to hospital | be in hospital |
| go to prison | be in prison |
| go to church | be in / at church |
| go to bed | be in bed |
| go home | be at home |

## С the
| Идти | Находиться |
|---|---|
| go to **the** cinema | be at **the** cinema |
| go to **the** theatre | be at **the** theatre |
| go to **the** bank | be in / at **the** bank |
| go to **the** post office | be at **the** post office |
| go to **the** doctor | be at **the** doctor's |
| go to **the** dentist | be at **the** dentist's |
| go to **the** station / airport | be at **the** station / airport |

## Формулы
> go **to** + work / school / bed / hospital ... (без the)
> go **home** (без to)
> go to **the** + cinema / bank / doctor ... (с the)

exercises.instruction: Вставьте **to, at, in** или **-** (если слова не нужно). Если слова не нужно, напишите **-**.
exercises.example: I'm tired. I'm going ... bed. → I'm going **to** bed.

exercises.title: Диалоги
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужные слова: **to, at, in, the** (или **-**).

items.text: A: Where is Tom? B: He's {{at}} work.
A: Where are you going? B: I'm going {{to}} the bank.
A: Is Mary ill? B: Yes, she's {{in}} bed.
A: Are you going out tonight? B: No, I'm staying {{at}} home.
A: Where does Paul study? B: He's {{at}} university.
A: How is your mother? B: She's {{in}} hospital.
